headline: Agenda lists Title IX policy revisions and a recommendation to repeal three goals policies, with no outcomes recorded in the posted document.
summary: The agenda lists approval of revisions to policies 5145.5 and 4000.1, both titled Title IX. It also lists a recommendation to repeal policies 0200, 0210, and 0220, and an information item on three policies under review.
plain_text:
Policy Committee of the Hamden Board of Education 
 
ANNOUNCEMENT OF MEETING AND AGENDA 
TUESDAY, OCTOBER 20, 2026 
Public Session: 5:00 PM  
 
Join from PC, Mac, iPad, or Android: 
https://hamden.zoom.us/j/88360421427?pwd=zWHicBakbUm60GD6hQ3QhhBLwbtjiF.1  
Passcode: 630603 
 
Join via audio: 
+1 646 931 3860 US 
Webinar ID: 883 6042 1427 
Passcode: 630603 
 
Note: Any member of the public may request, in writing, a physical location and “any electronic equipment necessary” to attend 
the meeting in real time. Said request shall be made to tdonnarummo@hamden.org not less than twenty-four (24) hours prior 
to the meeting. 
 
For those who wish to make Public Comments:  
Twenty minutes will be allotted for public comments at the beginning of the meeting.  
There will be time set aside for public input during this meeting.  We ask that public comments be limited to no more than 1 
minute in length.  You may also submit your comment in writing.  Public comments should be sent to PublicInput@hamden.org, 
with the subject of the message stating the name and date of the meeting (for example, “May 12 Operations Committee 
Meeting”).  
 
Please note the following: 
• The name and Hamden address of the person submitting public comment must be included in the message.  
• Remarks should be brief and concise, with a maximum length of three minutes (about 450 characters).  
• Comments should start with a 2-3 sentence summary. The summary will be read instead of the entire message in the 
event that there is a large number of comments and reading each of them in their entirety would extend beyond the 
time allotted for public comment.  
• Public comments will be accepted up to 1 hour before the meeting begins. 
 
1. Call to order and roll call 
Committee members: Nancy Hill, Chris Piscitelli, Mario Ciccarini 
Administration: Gary Highsmith, Heather Wachter 
 
2. Additions to the agenda 
No additions 
 
3. Public Comment on agenda items 
No comments 
 
4. Information Items 
 
a. Revisions to the following policies: Graduation Requirements, External and Online Credits, and 
Challenging Curriculum are currently under review. 
Gary Highsmith 
 
5. Action Items 
 
a. Approval of revisions to the BOE of the following policies: 
i. 5145.5 Title IX Sex Discrimination and Harassment 
Motion by: Nancy Hill 
Second by: Chris Piscitelli
Unanimous 
ii. 4000.1 Title IX 
Motion by: Nancy Hill 
Second by: Chris Piscitelli 
Unanimous 
 
b. Approval to recommend to the BOE repeal of the following policies: 
i. 0200 Goals/Objectives 
ii. 0210 Goals/Accomplishments for Student Accomplishment 
iii. 0220 Goals/Objectives for School Operations 
 
Motion by: Nancy Hill 
Second by: Chris Piscitelli 
Unanimous 
 
6. Adjourn
